Why Blue?

Xist Publishing 2014

Maya is always wondering. On this particular afternoon she looks up at the sky and asks herself the classic question, "Why is the sky blue?" Through a series of encounters with people she meets throughout the day, Maya is presented with several intriguing explanations.
